author: AstroBlue
what_it_is: All Missions Completed except WAR! and Maian SOS on Perfect Agent. All Cheats unlocked except Farsight, which is obsolete anyway because of the "All Guns in Solo" cheat.
format: DexDrive .n64: "123-456-STD" and a 0x1040-byte header (DexPlorer comments), then a 32 KiB Controller Pak: note NPDP/4Y "PERFECT DARK" (the PAL game code), 28 pages, and two entries with no pages (ND4P CASTLEVANIA2, a GameShark "SMSM")

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/n64-dexdrive.py convert perfect-dark-2000.1169.n64 OUT: dexdrive: pak = the 32768 bytes after the 0x1040-byte header

converted_standalone.how: the same bytes as the .srm regions, as standalone Mupen64Plus keeps them: <GoodName (32 chars)>-<MD5 8>.eep/.sra/.fla/.mpk in its save folder

verified.baseline: with no save the PAL game asks for a language, then Choose Your Reality lists only New Agent...

mupen64plus-next.detail: after the PAL game's language menu (A = English), Choose Your Reality lists Controller Pak 1: agent "AstroBlue", Skedar Ruins - Battle Shrine, mission time 2:11:19.42
